relationship_scope.claim: Questions the uniqueness and uniformity of European family patterns
relationship_scope.evidence: Primary 8–9 distinguishes kinship questions from demographic measures, stresses regional/social variation and considers Tibet/Roman Egypt counterexamples. The cited studies themselves were not independently checked.

relationship_scope.claim: Challenges Europe-centred templates for world historical comparison
relationship_scope.evidence: Introduction 1–3 criticizes projecting European categories onto other societies and asks why Eurasian similarities disappear from divergence narratives. His argument is represented as a comparative challenge, not a proven global consensus.
